title: How Each Zodiac Sign Says I Love You (Without Saying It)

segments.text: Every zodiac sign says I love you, without ever saying it.

segments.title: ARIES
segments.text: Aries races you there, just to hear you laugh.

segments.title: TAURUS
segments.text: Taurus cooks for you. Every single time.

segments.title: GEMINI
segments.text: Gemini talks with you until sunrise.

segments.title: CANCER
segments.text: Cancer remembers the smallest thing you said.

segments.title: LEO
segments.text: Leo shows you off to the whole world.

segments.title: LIBRA
segments.text: Libra makes your whole world softer.

segments.title: SCORPIO
segments.text: Scorpio tells you the secret they never tell.

segments.title: CAPRICORN
segments.text: Capricorn builds a future with your name in it.

segments.title: AQUARIUS
segments.text: Aquarius lets you be your strangest self.

segments.title: PISCES
segments.text: Pisces feels your pain before you say it.
Which one loves like you? Comment your sign, and send this to them.
